metadata.description: Claude Code Mods: model-watch, usage-band, delete-guard

plugins.name: model-watch
plugins.description: Records which model answered each request and shows it in a band above the prompt

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Shows 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt at all times

plugins.name: delete-guard
plugins.description: Asks for a reason and impact before recursive delete commands and shows a confirmation dialog
